arguments.command:
cd /workspace/examples && for f in native-atlas native-pack native-trace; do echo "=== $f"; /workspace/tmp/engine < $f.in.native > /tmp/out.nat 2>/tmp/err.nat; echo "rc=$?"; python3 -c "
import sys
a=open('$f.out.native').read().split()
b=open('/tmp/out.nat').read().split()
print('MATCH' if a==b else 'MISMATCH')
if a!=b:
    print('exp',a); print('got',b)
"; cat /tmp/err.nat; done
